deferred_and_excluded.enabled: See sources.json and data/source-status.json for live results; each run is bounded by page/detail limits.
deferred_and_excluded.eg-pc.com: Redirects to Qarenly; collected once through Qarenly.
deferred_and_excluded.Smart Technology: Pending an unambiguous store URL; do not guess which business this name refers to.
deferred_and_excluded.btech.com: Comparison-only collection; not eligible for buying alerts.
deferred_and_excluded.ubuy.com.eg: Import baseline deferred; do not compare imported prices without shipping/taxes and exchange-rate evidence.
deferred_and_excluded.reference_specs: The schema and exact-MPN reference join are implemented. Supply verified manufacturer/reference facts in references.json; missing facts remain null. Automatic crawling of all reference databases is deferred.
deferred_and_excluded.market_baselines: Exchange-rate import is supported through the fx command. RAM indices and PCPartPicker price history are deferred.
deferred_and_excluded.reputation: Deferred. No store risk score is fabricated from missing review data. Official Reddit/YouTube/Places APIs require their own credentials.
deferred_and_excluded.used_lifetimes: Not implemented in this MVP while Dubizzle is blocked. Disappeared listings cannot establish actual sale price.
never_collect: Dubizzle seller names, profile data and phone numbers
Private Facebook groups, seller profiles, contacts, messages and credentials
deferred_and_excluded.marketplaces: Amazon/Noon receive a small daily public sample; other marketplaces use discovered hardware URLs. Consult hardware/coverage-and-gaps.json for actual results; do not mistake a reachable homepage for product coverage.
deferred_and_excluded.market_boundary: Only configured online sources and their public feed/sitemap/search inventories. Unknown stores, offline stock, private groups and inventories absent from public pages remain outside measured coverage.
deferred_and_excluded.unsupported_fields: Unknown RAM capacity, DDR type, form factor, module count, warranty, shipping, benchmarks and PSU quality remain explicit gaps. No values are invented.
deferred_and_excluded.accessories_and_tech: Accessories, peripherals, audio, gaming/VR, creator equipment, maker tools, smart-home gear, wearables, tablets and e-readers from configured public sources. Specialist stores not in sources.json, offline inventories, opaque marketplace titles/URLs and missing compatibility remain outside measured coverage. No claim of every accessory in Egypt.
deferred_and_excluded.facebook_marketplace: Public Egypt HTTP probe enabled at user request. Live cloud test on 2026-10-06 collected zero listings: robots.txt disallows Marketplace. One access failure stops the probe; retry no more than daily. No authenticated Facebook session or connection to the owner's PC exists here. Local Chrome collection is a separate, owner-operated option; visible candidates have unconfirmed availability.

limits: Coverage measures configured sources and discovered inventories, not the whole Egyptian market. An accessible homepage is not a harvested catalogue.
